title: China's digital expansion in the Global South: Systematic literature review and future research agenda
notes: Peer-reviewed systematic literature review (75 included items) by a recognized development-studies scholar. Cited as the academic review of China's digital expansion in the Global South under Social.
claims: China's digital expansion in the Global South dates to at least the 1980s; scaled through Going Out (1999), BRI (2013), Digital/Information Silk Road (2015+)
Expansion worth billions of US$ annually in trade and investment; impacts growth, inequality, sustainability, sovereignty, security
Reviews whether China exports 'digital authoritarianism' and implications for global/national digital governance (framed as contested)
75 items included in the review; ~19% of authors based in the Global South
Six-part future research agenda incl. 'local agency in a digital Cold War'
